description: Airbed supervisor lock 2026-10-29 05:42 UTC (01:42 ET). Ghost first called 'the supervisor lock' the root cause. The panel station stopped answering (47 fields null), extraction_bag_watchdog tripped on the missing vent_or_bag_valve input and its recovery failed with MemoryParityError until the station came back at 07:07 UTC. The pin remap 731e0e8 was live on the same riser but unrelated: its output was not written for 8.7h before onset and a remap cannot drop a station. (Spark, 2026-10-29: the pin swap caused the morning valve failure, the watchdog fired separately.)

messages.text: @Ghost airbed locked early this morning and the bag valve stopped switching. Why did it lock?

ground_truth: Lock at 05:42:22 UTC: the panel_station (192.168.105.100) stopped answering at 05:42:20 — 45 panel fields incl. vent_or_bag_valve went null; extraction_bag_watchdog trips on missing inputs; extraction_bag_recovery's writes failed with Modbus(Device(MemoryParityError)) every ~4.5 s until the station recovered at 07:07:03 UTC. Why the station dropped is not established. 731e0e8 (gas-out valve OD7→OD6 on riser 5) was live but is not the cause: the valve was not written overnight and a remap does not drop a Modbus station. The earlier watchdog trips at 19:33 and 20:09 UTC Oct 28 recovered normally.
